root_cause: The security hardening change applied a default-deny-all NetworkPolicy to the billing namespace, and no NetworkPolicy was added to allow ingress to postgres on 5432, so billing-api's connections to postgres are dropped.
evidence: kubectl-get-networkpolicy.yaml: default-deny-all NetworkPolicy (podSelector: {}, policyTypes Ingress) created 2026-10-30T09:18:44Z, minutes before the timeouts began
kubectl-get-networkpolicy.yaml: the only NetworkPolicy in the namespace is the default-deny — nothing allows ingress to postgres on 5432
billing-api.log: PSQLException connect timed out to postgres.billing.svc.cluster.local:5432 while DNS resolution of the same name succeeds
kubectl-get-pods-show-labels.txt: billing-api and postgres pods are all Running and Ready, so this is not a pod-level failure
kubectl-get-svc-postgres.yaml: postgres Service selector and port 5432 are correct (red herring)
postgres.log: postgres healthy with no connection attempts logged (red herring)
fix: Add a NetworkPolicy in the billing namespace that allows ingress from pods labeled app=billing-api to postgres pods on TCP port 5432.
